name: Airbase
purpose: Aerial detection and instance-segmentation inspection in a cluttered ground scene.

packaged_sample.note: Two frames occur in both distributions, so archive frame and instance totals are not unique-run totals.

camera_policy: Four authored camera zones looking at one target, with scene weather.
limitations: The verification pass reported three visible people without a published bounding box among ninety people inspected; the failing check ships in the sample report.
Four camera zones aimed at one target cover a narrow band of viewing angles and distances.
The class distribution is uneven because the source scene is uneven.
Thirteen unique packaged frames from a forty-frame source run are suitable for inspection, not benchmarking.
